sentences.en: All work and no play makes Jack a dull boy.
sentences.zh: 只工作不玩耍，聪明的孩子也会变傻。

sentences.en: The latter half of the drama was a little dull.
sentences.zh: 这部戏剧后半部分有点乏味。

sentences.en: Kozue thought the teacher's lecture was dull, boring and endless.
sentences.zh: 小泉觉得老师的讲解很无聊，枯燥无趣且没完没了。
